title: Add a checked integer division to a small calculator package
request: Add a function `Divide(a, b int) (int, error)` to package calc. It returns the integer quotient of a and b, truncated toward zero as Go's / operator does (for example, Divide(7, 2) is 3 and Divide(-7, 2) is -3). When b is 0 it returns the exported sentinel error `ErrDivideByZero`, declared as a package-level error value, so that errors.Is(err, ErrDivideByZero) holds. Add unit tests for the new behaviour.
